baseline_system_findings.strongest_supportable_repo_system: R1 coordinator + R3 safety monitor + a new external outcome/eval harness; R5-R7 are not required for the minimum proof slice.
baseline_system_findings.strongest_supportable_employer_intersect: reliable autonomous-agent harnessing under resource confounds and action-containment constraints; not established as Anthropic's single hardest problem.
baseline_system_findings.candidate_invention: confound-aware, outcome-graded agent harness combining deterministic work coordination with pre-execution action policy boundaries and separate evaluator semantics.
baseline_system_findings.proof_gap: No integrated executable artifact yet demonstrates R1+R3 behavior under controlled resource variation, adversarial tool use, and independent outcome grading.
baseline_system_findings.causal_worker_science_state: NOT_STARTED; baseline quality exists but ablation has not been run.

measurement_gaps: Per-worker execution time was not exposed by the direct connector return.
Complete persistent raw responses were not captured by the direct connector path, so exact overlap is unavailable.
Marginal system value and outcome leverage require counterfactual ablation and are intentionally null.
Provider diversity is one; eight worker calls are not eight independent model families.
truth_boundary: These scores are a fixed supervisory review of the first real production specimen, not causal proof that a worker improves the system. The same rubric must be used for the matched Turn 1 comparison.
